name: eq_or_eq_neg_of_isEmpty
statement: Orientation R M ι) : o = positiveOrientation ∨ o = -positiveOrientation

name: eq_or_eq_neg
statement: Orientation R M ι) (h : Fintype.card ι = finrank R M) : x₁ = x₂ ∨ x₁ = -x₂

name: map_eq_neg_iff_det_neg
statement: Orientation R M ι) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (h : Fintype.card ι = finrank R M) : Orientation.map ι f x = -x ↔ LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[R] M) < 0
